intelill_norm.definition: The usual result of a group, used as the point of comparison.
intelill_norm.example: Compare the mark with the norm for that group, not with the mark alone.

noon.definition: The middle of the day, around twelve o'clock. It is also called midday.

red.definition: The colour of blood or fire.

war_tactics.definition: The level of the local action: how a unit is used in one fight and how it is moved on the field.
war_tactics.example: The report describes tactics when it explains how the advance was carried out.
